@graph.name: How to Apply to Become an EarlyJobs Recruiter
@graph.description: The application process for people interested in participating in the EarlyJobs recruiter network.

step.name: Apply to join
step.text: Submit your details through the EarlyJobs recruiter application form.

step.name: Application review
step.text: Your application may be reviewed against the applicable onboarding requirements.

step.name: Complete onboarding
step.text: Follow the onboarding process and review the applicable working arrangements and programme terms.

step.name: Explore relevant hiring requirements
step.text: Review suitable hiring mandates made available to you, subject to availability and programme terms.

step.name: Participate in recruitment
step.text: Undertake agreed recruitment activities for relevant requirements under the applicable mandate terms.

mainEntity.name: What is a freelance recruiter at EarlyJobs?

acceptedAnswer.text: A freelance recruiter works independently on recruitment requirements made available through EarlyJobs, helping identify and engage suitable candidates in line with the agreed process.

mainEntity.name: Can I work from home as an EarlyJobs recruiter?

acceptedAnswer.text: The recruiter programme is designed to offer flexibility in where you work. Specific requirements, communication expectations and deadlines depend on the mandate and programme terms.

mainEntity.name: Can women returning after a career break apply?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Women looking to return to recruitment or explore flexible professional opportunities can apply, subject to the programme's onboarding and role requirements.

mainEntity.name: Do I need previous recruitment experience?

acceptedAnswer.text: Relevant recruitment or HR experience can help establish suitability for particular hiring requirements. Applicants without prior experience should check the current eligibility criteria and whether a suitable entry-level pathway is available.

mainEntity.name: How do freelance recruiters earn with EarlyJobs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Commercial terms and payment arrangements are governed by the applicable recruiter programme or mandate agreement. Placements and earnings are not guaranteed.
EarlyJobs connects recruiters with available hiring opportunities through its network. Access to specific mandates depends on availability, suitability and the applicable onboarding process.

mainEntity.name: Can I choose my working hours?

acceptedAnswer.text: Freelance recruitment offers flexibility, but recruiters are expected to meet agreed deadlines, candidate communication expectations and hiring timelines.

mainEntity.name: How do I get started as an EarlyJobs recruiter?

acceptedAnswer.text: Complete the recruiter application form. The EarlyJobs team can review your details and share the relevant onboarding process and next steps.
